title: 第3831章 霸道九天仙宗弟子第3830章 狂妄硬撼
lines: 玄青宗宗主瞳孔忍不住的一缩，脸上也是露出了一抹惊骇之色。
他的杀招竟然被许辰以如此轻描淡写的方式化解了。
怎么会这样？
玄青宗宗主心头忽然涌起了一丝极其强烈的不安。
他之前是忌惮许辰的身份，以及其背后的势力，而现在则是忌惮许辰的实力。
他怎么也没料到，许辰这么一个看起来二十岁出头的青年，实力竟然如此恐怖。
周武此刻嘴巴微微张大，一副惊骇不已的模样。
下一刻。
他身体猛地一个激灵，反应了过来，而后露出了惊喜之色。
他原本对这一战已经做好了落败的心理准备，同时也做好了赴死的准备，可许辰的表现，着实令人吃惊，而他从许辰的身上，也终于是看到了获胜的希望。
“天仙境，不过如此！”
许辰抬头看向玄青宗宗主，摇了摇头，一副颇为失望的模样。
“如果你只有这点实力的话，那么，这一战，可以结束了！”
说着，许辰一步跨出，斗转星移发动，直接身形一闪，欺身到了玄青宗宗主近前，然后没有任何的迟疑，一拳猛地轰出。
这一拳毫无花哨，没有施展任何强大的招式，但这一拳却蕴含着无比强大的力量……
玄青宗宗主呼吸不由得一滞，他从许辰的这一拳之中，感受到了一股令他心悸的强大力量。
拳头与战刀结结实实的对轰在了一起。
然而。
对轰的那一瞬间，玄青宗宗主脸色却是猛地一变，他只觉一股极为恐怖的力量，如同山洪海啸一般，自许辰的拳头之上席卷而出，震得他身体狂震，紧握战刀的手掌几乎失去了知觉，而他更是闷哼一声，狼狈无比的飞了出去。
许辰脚下空气炸开，而他的身体则是化作一道残影，瞬间追上了倒飞中的玄青宗宗主，然后抡起双拳，拳头如同雨点一般疯狂落下，笼罩向玄青宗宗主。
“轰轰轰轰轰轰轰！！！！”
一连串低沉的碰撞声顿时响彻而起。
拳头与战刀疯狂碰撞。
玄青宗宗主拼命挥刀抵挡。
然而。
每一次碰撞，对他来说，都是一次不小的冲击，眨眼之间，两人便是碰撞了数十次，而玄青宗宗主紧握战刀的双手，虎口早已崩裂，手掌一片血肉模糊……
又是一次凶狠的碰撞。
霸道的力量通过战刀直接轰入玄青宗宗主的体内，令得他身体狂震，一口鲜血狂喷了出来，然后整个人宛如断线纸鸢一般倒飞了出去。
轰隆一声。
在周武与周元呆滞的注视之下，玄青宗宗主竟是如同死狗一般，从半空中狠狠地砸入下方废墟之中，地面都是为之剧烈一震，而在那废墟中则是多出了一个大坑。
周武见状，大脑先是陷入一阵短暂的空白，而后，他猛地惊醒了过来，眨了眨眼睛，待确定这一切不是梦之后，整个人便是忍不住的露出了狂喜之色。
赢了！
赢了！
content_en:
"What?!"
The head of the Xuan Qing Sect couldn't help but shrink his pupils, and there was a look of horror on his face.
His killing move was actually resolved by Xu Chen in such an understatement.
how so?
The head of the Xuan Qing Sect suddenly felt an extremely strong uneasiness in his heart.
He used to be wary of Xu Chen's identity and the power behind it, but now he is wary of Xu Chen's strength.
He never expected that Xu Chen, a young man who looked to be in his early twenties, would be so terrifyingly powerful.
Zhou Wu's mouth was slightly open at this moment, looking horrified.
The next moment.
His body suddenly trembled and he reacted, then showed a look of surprise.
He had been mentally prepared for defeat in this battle, and was also prepared to die. However, Xu Chen's performance was really surprising, and he finally saw the hope of victory from Xu Chen.
"The Heavenly Realm is nothing more than that!"
Xu Chen looked up at the head of the Xuanqing Sect and shook his head, looking quite disappointed.
"If you only have this strength, then this battle can be over!"
Saying that, Xu Chen took a step forward and activated the Star Shift. In a flash, he came to the head of the Xuan Qing Sect, and then without any hesitation, he punched out fiercely.
There is nothing fancy about this punch, and it does not use any powerful moves, but this punch contains extremely powerful power...
The leader of the Xuanqing Sect couldn't help but feel his breath stagnate. From Xu Chen's punch, he felt a powerful force that made his heart palpitate.
"Boom!"
The fist and the sword clashed together firmly.
However.
At the moment of the confrontation, the face of the leader of the Xuanqing Sect suddenly changed. He felt an extremely terrifying force, like a mountain torrent and a tsunami, sweeping out from Xu Chen's fist, shaking his body wildly. The palm of his hand that clenched the sword almost lost consciousness, and he even let out a muffled groan and flew out in embarrassment.
"Bang!"
The air exploded under Xu Chen's feet, and his body turned into an afterimage, instantly catching up with the leader of the Xuanqing Sect who was flying upside down. Then he raised his fists, and the fists fell crazily like raindrops, covering the leader of the Xuanqing Sect.
"Boom boom boom boom boom!!!!"
A series of low collision sounds suddenly resounded.
Fists and swords collided wildly.
The head of Xuanqing Sect waved his sword desperately to resist.
However.
Every collision was a big impact for him. In the blink of an eye, the two of them collided dozens of times. The master of the Xuanqing Sect clenched the sword in his hands. The tiger's mouth had already cracked, and his palms were a bloody mess...
"Boom!!!!"
Another vicious collision.
"Pfft~"
The overbearing power was directly blasted into the body of the Xuanqing Sect leader through the sword, causing his body to shake wildly, a mouthful of blood spurting out, and then the whole person flew out like a broken paper kite.
There was a boom.
Under the dull gazes of Zhou Wu and Zhou Yuan, the leader of the Xuanqing Sect was like a dead dog, slamming into the ruins below from mid-air. The ground shook violently, and a large pit appeared in the ruins.
Seeing this, Zhou Wu's brain fell into a brief blank for a while. Then, he suddenly woke up and blinked. After confirming that this was not a dream, his whole body couldn't help but show a look of ecstasy.
Win!
Win!
